text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон and I go out for lunch at a
buffet.

Oh, you've got a pretty good spread
there! Which sides did you end
up
grabbing?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Wait, those plate colors look familiar... Is it
just me, or do you get the
exact same
thing every time we come here?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that I always seem to
inadvertently pick out the
grilled dishes.

Geez, I expected better from you, Teach!
You can't let yourself fall
into a routine
like that!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That's not how you stay healthy. You gotta
quit eating the same ol'
things and
broaden those nutritional horizons!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And working out is just as important.
Speaking of, I've actually been

wondering...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: You are exercising, right, Teach? You're not making us bust our butts while you sit back and take it easy, are ya?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: I work out a decent amount...

text_block_list.text: "Decent"? If you think that's enough for a trainer to stay in shape, you're way off base!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I can't just let this one slide. All right,
leave it to ol' Hishiama! I'll get
that bod of
yours nice and toned up, or I ain't the
leader of the Miho
Dorm!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Now, c'mon—follow me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We'll start off with some light jogging! But
the lesson won't be over
'til you manage to
pass me! Ready, set, hyaaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
What're you walking for? ...Wait, you call
that running? You're never
gonna slim
down creepin' along at a snail's pace like
that.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Next up is strength training. And I don't
mean some half-assed
regimen where you
do one set and call it a day. We're talkin'
circuit
training!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Arms, legs, abs! Arms, legs, abs! Just when
you think it's time for a
break, we work
that back! Show me a bow pose!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
What's with that lousy form? C'mon, you
gotta bend more! Can't be a
bow without
loops!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hey, what're you slacking off for? This is a
one-on-one, not a
lie-on-floor!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Wait, Teach?! Oh, for cryin' out loud.
What gives? I've never seen
such a sorry
sight.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Okay, maaaybe I got a little too
fired up. Sorry 'bout that,
I'm just wired
that way.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
When I help somebody out, I've got to see
it through to the very end.
Otherwise it
just doesn't sit right with me, y'know?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: You sound like a doting wife.

text_block_list.text: A-a wife?! Enough with the mushy stuff! It's not like I'm doing it out of the goodness of my heart.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I just always wanna take the lead. So I've
got no clue what it's like to
run a
three-legged race with somebody.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Even when it comes to you, I still don't
really know the right way to
act together
and build a friendship.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I may be a pro at one-on-ones, but this
whole hand-in-hand thing is
another story.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: You'll get used to it little by little.

text_block_list.text:
Little by little, huh? Yeah... Not sure if I
can pull it off, but I'll have to
give it a try!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
After all, the two of us are just getting
started!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Right on! Hahaha, looks like you've
bounced back a bit.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And that means... break time is over! Let's
get back to the workout.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with the look of horror? Like I
said, once I've decided to
help somebody,
I never give up on 'em.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So lemme see those legs moving! Hahaha,
it's hard to tell which one
of us is the
trainer at this point. Can't say I mind it
though!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Despite being unsure how to match
another person's stride and pace,
Amazon
nevertheless sets out to run her first
proverbial three-legged
race.
